verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents an auto-shutdown timer, idle-instance termination, budget cap, or spend limit for CoreWeave compute. Node Pool quotas cap capacity, not spend. Billing insights, FOCUS export, and Grafana cost dashboards only report usage. The Cluster Autoscaler scales on workload demand rather than acting as a shutdown timer. All of these are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can set auto-shutdown timers or spend limits so a forgotten instance can't silently run up a huge bill
